panels.description: The number of SLIs that are meeting their SLO objective in the last 1d

targets.expr:
count(
		(
		  sum by (grafana_slo_uuid) (sum_over_time((grafana_slo_success_rate_5m < +Inf)[1d:5m]))
		  / sum by (grafana_slo_uuid) (sum_over_time((grafana_slo_total_rate_5m < +Inf)[1d:5m]))
		  # combine with series that aren't producing grafana_slo_success_rate_5m and grafana_slo_total_rate_5m
		  or avg by (grafana_slo_uuid) (grafana_slo_sli_1d)
		)
		> on(grafana_slo_uuid) grafana_slo_objective
	  ) OR on() vector(0)

panels.title: ⬆️ 1d target
